note: Both arms compare the shipped adapter against @xenova/transformers 2.17.2 on the same weights and the same 15 texts. The second arm exists because v2 defaulted to quantized weights and v4 defaults to fp32: it is the difference a caller who upgrades without pinning dtype would see. The rerank block is a different claim: distinct, correctly ordered scores from the local cross-encoder, which the text-classification pipeline cannot produce because it softmaxes over a single label.
